blurb: Guests fish for various species including trout, bass, musky, walleye, and more on guided trips using boats or wading in streams. Trips vary in duration and group size, with professional guides providing gear and instruction. Specialty trips include fly fishing on trout streams, bass fishing with a Major League Fishing pro, musky fishing, and party barge outings.
